Collaborating with local contractors/vendors/departments to manage these processes through to completion, ensuring compliance with local and state building codes.* Site Coordination: Managing and coordinating the logistics involved in opening, relocating, or closing a facility, including security systems, access control, furniture, signage, showroom/marketing requirements, telecommunications, and more.* Budgeting and Capital Expenditure: Actively participating in the capital expenditure budgeting process and managing purchasing requests for facility needs. Accurately forecasting and preparing facility-related budgets. Conducting financial and business analysis, including preparing reports on expenditures, savings, and areas for cost optimization.* Compliance and Standards Development: Ensuring all facilities are operated and maintained in compliance with local, state, and national laws, company standards, and procedures. Responsible for developing and refining standards as business needs evolve, including ensuring annual occupational safety and fire inspections where applicable.* Stakeholder and Management Communication: Maintaining a dotted line to the local management teams, participating in and reporting at management meetings. Building strong relationships with key business stakeholders by collecting feedback and delivering reports on business-critical aspects, such as occupancy, site launches, and facility improvements and audits.* External Relations and First Point of Contact: Serving as the First Point of Contact for the landlord, labor inspectorate, municipalities, authorities, and occupational safety departments.* Vendor and Contractor Management: Building and maintaining strong relationships with local building management and managing third-party contractors/vendors responsible for facility maintenance and operations. This includes monitoring tasks completed, overseeing technical acceptance, and approving invoices.* Lease and Contract Management: Managing leases and facility agreements, including understanding legal terms and commercial contract structures. Ensuring contracts are renewed and negotiated in a timely manner.* Sustainability and Energy Efficiency: Supporting sustainability initiatives by tracking, reporting, and working towards reducing emissions and waste across facility operations. Implementing energy-saving initiatives, including tracking energy consumption and suggesting areas for improvement.* Crisis and Emergency Management: Developing and maintaining emergency response plans for the facility, including fire drills, evacuation procedures, and pandemic-related safety measures.* Training and Development: Coordinating safety and facility-related training for employees to ensure everyone is aware of evacuation procedures, safety protocols, and proper usage of shared resources like conference rooms, equipment, and storage areas.* Team Collaboration and Support: Contributing to team success by assisting colleagues in resolving internal issues and supporting shared goals.* Quality and Standards Management: Ensuring adherence to organizational SOPs by regularly reviewing and understanding operational guidelines. Supporting the establishment and enforcement of departmental standards to maintain consistent quality service.* Technical and Industry Development: Enhancing expertise through active participation in company-sponsored training programs and maintaining up-to-date knowledge of industry trends and emerging technologies to drive innovation and informed decision-making.WHAT WE LOOK FOR* Bachelor’s degree in Facility Management or a comparable degree with a technical background, alongside additional business management training or further development.* Five or more years of experience in facilities management or an equivalent role, including proven experience in managing technical building projects.* Fluent language skills in both German and English are required. Additional language skills are beneficial.* Flexibility to travel between our German sites when needed, with an average travel requirement of ~10%.* Organizational and time management skills to prioritize tasks and meet established schedules, timelines, or deadlines.* Creative problem-solving skills with strong project management abilities.* Proficiency in working with computer software, including the MS Office suite.* Ability to influence others without direct authority.* Strong ability to adapt to changing priorities.* A strong desire to succeed while maintaining a professional and positive attitude.At Clario, our purpose is to transform lives by unlocking better evidence. The approach reduces lead time from months to days while ensuring that each tank is qualified and flight-ready. Blackwave's mission is to end COPV failure in spaceflight. The company employs more than 150 people across manufacturing facilities in Germany and Texas.More information at Blackwave.com and the procurement platform COPV.com.Technical Project Manager (m/f/d) Aerospace CompositesTaufkirchen / Full-time / Permanent employee YOUR RESPONSIBILITIESYour mission is to lead and manage the full life-cycle of our internal COPV product development projects, ensuring technical excellence and efficient execution from concept to serial production.- Own Internal Project Management: You are responsible for the entire project management of our new COPVs from initial component design and tool concept through prototype and series production, and additionally, open to managing other projects within the company.- Develop Technical Solutions: You evaluate new product ideas from a technical perspective, assist the team with developing robust production concepts, and calculating internal manufacturing costs.- Coordinate Execution: You manage all project activities, resources, and timelines, ensuring all technical and operational project goals are achieved successfully.- Drive Cross-Functional Collaboration: You will work closely with our core internal teams: Part Design & FEM, Toolmaking, Materials & Processes, Production, and Quality Management.- Documentation & Standards: You ensure comprehensive project documentation and adherence to internal standards and quality requirements throughout the development process.- Internal Stakeholder Management: You act as the central point of contact, providing clear communication and aligning expectations across all internal departments involved in product development.YOUR PROFILE- Manufacturing and Material Expertise: You are a proactive, solution-oriented project manager with deep expertise in advanced materials and manufacturing processes.- Educational Background: A degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Materials Science, or a similar technical field is essential.- Technical Expertise: You are quickly able to understand difficult technical problems and can challenge your project team on their decisions. You can guide the team to making sensible technical decisions and are comfortable with making technical decisions if needed.- Professional Experience: You bring several years of experience in product development and technical project management, ideally within the aerospace or high-tech manufacturing sectors.- Language Skills: Proficiency in English is needed to communicate effortlessly and precisely within the team; German is also nice to have.- Mindset & Skills: We look for someone who is quick on the uptake, possesses strong analytical skills, and demonstrates a practical, solution-oriented approach to complex technical challenges. jobs.description: A Snapshot of Your Day As a Senior Performance Controller (f/m/d), you will assess business performance and provide insights that drive strategic decision-making. Imagine preparing comprehensive internal reports and analyzing deviations from financial plans while managing budgeting and forecasting processes across various regions. You will engage in in-depth financial and business analytics, translating complex data into clear, actionable recommendations for senior management. A significant aspect of your role will be to champion digitalization and process optimization within your area, enhancing cost transparency and reporting accuracy through continuous improvement initiatives. How You’ll Make an Impact * Prepare internal reports, comment on key performance indicators, and analyze deviations from plans or forecasts* Conduct regular financial and business analytics to identify significant trends and opportunities for senior management* Summarize and communicate complex financial results and analyses in a clear and concise format* Manage the quality and integrity of financial reporting, ensuring strict compliance with corporate guidelines and standards* Coordinate and manage the budgeting, forecasting, and actual reporting cycles across multiple regions and functionsWhat You Bring* A degree in Business Administration, Economics, Finance, Accounting, or a related field* Long-term professional experience in financial analysis, controlling, or accounting* Proficiency in SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC), Tableau, PowerBI or similar BI tools * Excellent communication in English with proven experience in summarizing and conveying complex information into concise business reports* Experience in project management within a finance context is considered an advantageAbout the TeamOur Transformation of Industry division is decarbonizing the industrial sector. We enable decarbonization of the industrial sector and the transition to sustainable processes, building on a strong industrial customer base, a global network, diverse technologies, and integrated execution capabilities.Who is Siemens Energy? At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideoOur Commitment to Diversity Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. Rewards/Benefits * In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us.
